source.implements: Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks and its Phase checklist boxes), the app goes to the home screen

Phase checklist: the army and detachment rules, options and abilities of the list ckListed / ckOptListed lists (unless a unit of the list has the option as an ability: listed as theirs; the same ability on several units one line, a copy the list cannot use apart) (the same one on several units one line), by data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js): To do now in each phase and turn its text says it is triggered (07.02: the phases; either turn: both), or under the moment it opens with (Start of the (first) battle round, End of your opponent's turn); Active now where its effect is used and it is not triggered; once-per-battle ones (perBattle; Kindred Sorcery's options each) under Once per battle, from where they are triggered, with the Overview's boxes; each line names its unit or source and opens the full text; a rule another rule of the list gives to units by keyword (g) says which and to whom; what a listed one puts in force from a rule of the list (f: "Riled up (War Cry) · Waaagh!", opening that rule) under Active now where its entry says, or When unclear; inert rules and abilities the list cannot use are listed, marked; listed ones the table cannot place under When unclear, those with no phase under No phase; no stratagems; each section a fold (closed until opened, kept for the session), its line counting each part; a box per line per section, kept per list; Reset clears them (with Undo), not the once-per-battle ones

an option of a rule or ability on the Phase checklist: listed when its own words are a fixed moment (s), or when its rule is listed and its own words are not a unit activation (a: Calistus, Salvus, Rendax)

which rules, abilities and options the Phase checklist lists (ckListed, ckOptListed): an entry derive marks s (seqTrigger), one data.js gives a moment that derive cannot place (ckStored), or a once-per-battle use (perBattle); an option when its own words are s, or its rule is listed and its own words are not a unit activation (a)

an option of a rule or ability on the Phase checklist: its own trigger (and where it is used); with none, where its effect is used (chosen when its rule is triggered: a once-per-battle one is listed there); with neither, its rule's trigger; not derivable: When unclear

data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js --write), the Phase checklist table: per rule and ability, from its own words (withoutOptions): s listed (seqTrigger: a sentence naming the start or end of a battle round, turn or phase, a Command phase, or another phase with a choice, with no unit activation: selected to…, each time / when this or a unit or model…, this unit's move or attacks, makes an attack / charge / move, is targeted, targets this, destroys, is destroyed, the first time); t the phases its text names (table 1's trigger) less those only its opening moment gives, at that moment, u where its effect is used (table 1's used-in), limited to the trigger's phases and turn when the text names them and states no duration (no until, this turn, next, for the rest of); none: positively no phase; x: not derivable; per option (optionsOf) s, a (its own words a unit activation), its own trigger only when it names one, where it is used, x when it has neither and no trigger of its rule; g: an ability it gives units by keyword; f: what it puts in force (inForce); the same words on several units must give one entry, else x

the Phase checklist's scope (CHECKLIST s): a sentence of the own words (durations and once-per-phase limits left out) naming the start or end of a battle round, turn or phase, a Command phase, or another phase with a choice (you can / select / choose), with no unit activation in it (selected to…, each time / when this or a unit or model…, this unit's move or attacks, makes an attack / charge / move, is targeted, targets this, destroys, is destroyed, the first time): what a unit's activation triggers is remembered from its datasheet

what a listed rule or ability puts in force from a rule defined elsewhere (CHECKLIST f, shown "Riled up (War Cry) · Waaagh!" under Active now): a bold term that is an army or detachment rule of its faction by name or alias, made a state of units by "is/are/be/become(s)" in a clause with no if/while/unless/when before it; its phases from coverOf on the duration in the same sentence

the phases a duration covers from where the text is triggered, in the order of a turn and the next (Core Rules 07): end of the phase: that phase (not from the start of the battle round: no phase is in progress, x); of the turn / this turn: the rest of that turn; of the next turn: the rest of that turn and the whole next one; until the start of your next turn or Command phase: the rest of that turn, and the opponent's turn after one of yours; end of the battle: every phase (also from the end of your opponent's turn); end of the battle round: every phase only from the start of the battle round; a trigger at the start of the battle round counts as each player's Command phase, at the end of your opponent's turn as before your turn; anything else x (When unclear)

judgement.code: const withoutOptions = (text, table) => { const t = rulesText(text); return optionsOf(t, table).reduce((s2, o) => s2.replace(o.text, ''), t).replace(/^(?:- )?\*\*Examples?(?::\*\*|\*\*:).*$/gim, ''); };

source.implements: a rule's or ability's own words for the Phase checklist table: its text without its italic notes, without the text of each of its options (each option has its own entry) and without worked "**Example:**" lines

judgement.code: const ckStored = (e, x) => e.x && x.at ? Object.assign({}, e, { x:0, at:x.at, stored:1 }) : e;

source.implements: a rule or ability derive cannot place (x) that data.js gives a moment (at): listed at that moment only (Harbingers of Dread, Icon of Khorne: Start of the battle round), not at its display phase tags; with no moment it stays not derivable
